_comment: QoS profiles for core/qos/qos-ctl.py. Each becomes one PCC rule (one QoS flow) on the UE's PDU session. 'port' is the UE's SOURCE port: the rule is written in downlink form ('to assigned PORT') and Open5GS swaps it for the uplink (docs/LESSONS.md). Bit rates in Mbit/s. A 5QI used here should have a qos: entry in the gNB config (RLC mode etc.); qos-ctl.py show warns when it has not.

camera-protected.description: Protected camera: GBR flow. Camera 1 leaves from this source port (the UE SNATs it).

camera-protected-small.description: Protected camera at a lower guaranteed rate, for a weaker radio.

video-priority.description: Non-GBR flow above the default (5QI 6), no guaranteed rate.

control-low-latency.description: Small, latency-sensitive traffic (5QI 3, GBR 1/2 Mbit/s). Needs a gNB qos entry for 5QI 3.
